nightlyRechargeResults.sleepTip: What a dreadful night! If you can, make up for lost sleep tonight. Set the stage for a good night's sleep by consciously winding down before bedtime. Do something you know relaxes you to improve the quality of your sleep.
nightlyRechargeResults.vitalityTip: Stay sharp and awake during the day by keeping hydrated. Drink fluids and eat water-rich foods. Dehydration can make you feel fatigued and cause a headache.
nightlyRechargeResults.exerciseTip: It's a good day to train. Since you've been training a lot lately, do what feels good.
